description: Void (cancel) an in-progress envelope. The envelope's status becomes VOIDED, all signers receive a cancellation notice, and the void is recorded in the audit trail. Use this when the sender needs to cancel a contract that has already been sent to signers. Fails if the envelope is already COMPLETED or already VOIDED — use get_envelope first to check status. After voiding, the envelope can be deleted via the dashboard or DELETE /api/v1/envelopes/{id}.

reason.description: Optional reason for voiding — included in the cancellation notice sent to signers, the audit event, and the webhook payload. Recommend providing one so signers understand why.

name: void_envelope
